desc: The potion is a plain indescriminate color and smells slightly foul.
When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to Fire type damage for 1 hour.
For other potions of resistance, roll on the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.tables.RollTable.JzLOE4IxcmxjLLuz]{Potion of Resistance} table.
name: potion of fire resistance
